notes: AIDao v1.0 release candidate. Preserves the validated v0.5 creation workflow while adding stronger planner and generated-project acceptance coverage, deterministic project revision and source-override conflict handling, a fine-grained-PAT-compatible isolated-branch Contents API transport, trusted repository_dispatch generated-app builds, explicit CI diagnostics, and a zero-cost default provider policy. Core operation remains local/deterministic by default; optional remote providers must be explicitly selected and use user-supplied credentials/funding. Credentials remain session-only; installation, publication, spending, destructive actions, and unsafe provider acquisition remain user-controlled.
